summary: Named doctors and WhatsApp on the page are strengths, but template leftovers and one number for two branches appear to cost you bookings.

findings.problem: The cookie banner appears to show raw template text such as {title} three times and Manage {vendor_count} vendors.
findings.cost: Visible code on the first screen makes a clinic look careless.

findings.problem: The Khobar and Riyadh sections appear to show the same phone number and the same map link, and Book now and Book a consultation appear to go to different pages.
findings.cost: Patients cannot tell which branch to visit or where to book.
findings.fix: Separate branch details and one booking flow.

findings.problem: The brand appears as La Clinica, La clinica and Laclinica, the header and logo appear twice, and a For inquiries heading appears to have no content.
findings.cost: Mixed naming and empty blocks weaken trust and search visibility.
findings.fix: One brand name and a clean layout.

findings.problem: The page appears to show no patient reviews, ratings or years in operation, only one doctor with a stated certification, and 'Best dental clinic in Riyadh' repeated without proof.
findings.cost: Unsupported claims and no reviews lose patients who compare clinics.

redesign: Clean consent banner and one brand name.
Separate branch details and one booking flow.
